_note: Self-owned $0 media library. Art = public-domain/CC0 works on Wikimedia Commons, fetched once by `npm run media:fetch` into public/media/art/ (license verified via the Commons API; credit fields are filled by that script). Memes, reaction GIFs (animated SVG) and charts are rendered locally at build time by src/lib/media.mjs. Keep everything PG: no nudity, gore or real living people.

memes.description: Two people disagreeing about where truth lives: one points up (abstract/ideal), one points down (concrete/practical).

slots.name: down
